occupations.title: Project Management Specialists
occupations.rationale: The product is explicitly described as a "project management application" and a competitor excerpt mentions the need for a "shared project management tool" to track project plans and progress [D:Asana:landing:3].

occupations.title: Software Developers
occupations.rationale: Trello's ability to integrate with Jira and a competitor's mention of integrations with tools like GitHub and managing work in "sprints" directly relates to the project management needs of software developers [D:Trello:features:5, D:ClickUp:landing:4].

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: A competitor excerpt explicitly names "marketing" as a team that tracks its work on a project launch, a process that involves managing the various tasks, deadlines, and workflows that Trello is designed to handle [D:Asana:landing:3].
